rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with the front matter `name: habeas-requirements`, so `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.workflow` applies to it. The requirement says each skill must open with its workflow as ordered steps, before any other section.

The file has front matter, then the title `# Habeas requirements` and a three-line intro paragraph. The first `##` section is `## Workflow`. It comes before `## Writing chapters`, `## Choosing references`, `## What the review checks` and `## Gotchas`, so no other section precedes it.

The workflow is a sequence of explicitly numbered steps, `- [ ] 1.` through `- [ ] 7.`, in execution order. Each step has the step number inside a checkbox bullet, so the order is explicit.

The intro paragraph is not a section. I read "before any other section" as allowing a title and a short preamble, so I don't count it as a gap. A stricter reading would require the workflow to come right after the front matter. That reading is a less natural fit for the wording, since the text says "section".

No violation matches were listed for this site.
